name: Genetics
boundaries: Genetics: fundamental discoveries and enabling technologies within this field. Include cross-field consequences where the central advance belongs to this field; exclude routine incremental optimization. Use the historical breakthroughs in the prompt to calibrate revolutionary impact.

original_dispositions.original_title: Origin and fixation of the standard genetic code
original_dispositions.reason: The historical claim that solving its origin would enable orthogonal synthetic codes has been narrowed: that is a possible downstream research direction, not a demonstrated consequence.
The historical claims of perfect therapy, arbitrary cell-fate design, and ending cancer are unsupported extrapolations and are not carried forward.

The revised concept asks for causal evidence and generality; it does not assume that environmentally acquired traits are faithfully inherited or that a fixed number of generations alone establishes the mechanism.

Explaining genome-size variation is a significant evolutionary question, but the supplied formulation does not establish a distinct transformative capability at the chosen threshold. A single functional purpose for all excess DNA is also an unwarranted premise; mechanisms may differ across lineages.

original_dispositions.original_title: Functions and integration of all orphan and de novo genes
original_dispositions.reason: These genes matter, but cataloguing every gene’s role is an open-ended collection of problems rather than a sufficiently defined general breakthrough. Elements of predicting sequence function overlap GEN-01 and GEN-11; those IDs do not claim to solve orphan-gene evolution.

original_dispositions.original_title: Complete epistatic map and higher-order architecture
original_dispositions.reason: It is framed as predictive causal capability for defined traits, rather than a literal map of every interaction or a promise to explain all phenotypic variance.

original_dispositions.original_title: Genome-wide suppression of selfish genetic elements
original_dispositions.reason: Host defenses and selfish elements are important, but the historical entry combines diverse mechanisms without defining a single demonstrated missing general capability. Repeat-expansion disease prevention and safe genome editing do not automatically follow. GEN-07 concerns engineered inheritance in populations, not universal host suppression.

original_dispositions.original_title: Dosage compensation across sexes and taxa
original_dispositions.reason: A comprehensive evolutionary account would be valuable, but the historical formulation is a broad unresolved question without a sufficiently distinct transformative capability for this list. Chromosome-level cures and complete explanations of aneuploid syndromes are unsupported downstream claims.

Mechanistic identification of hybrid incompatibilities is valuable, and some are already known, but an exhaustive multi-lineage catalogue alone does not clearly meet the selected threshold. The historical list’s prediction and control claims also require ecological and population-level evidence beyond identifying loci. A review by Maheshwari and Barbash, The genetics of hybrid incompatibilities, 2011, DOI 10.1146/annurev-genet-110410-132514, describes known mechanisms and unresolved evolutionary causes; abstract-only access was available here.

original_dispositions.original_title: General theory of evolvability and mutational robustness
original_dispositions.reason: A genuinely predictive theory could be transformative, but the supplied “universal principles” formulation does not yet specify a sufficiently concrete, independently testable capability beyond parts of GEN-11 and genome design in GEN-02. Neither retained ID claims to predict long-term evolution.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Preserved GEN-01 through GEN-09 and their underlying identities.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: All nine first-pass concepts and IDs are retained.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Updated GEN-02 with the 2026 account of all 16 synthetic yeast chromosomes and explicitly distinguished separate chromosomes from consolidation into one cell.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: The review’s consolidation section distinguishes those separate achievements from a fully consolidated cell and describes six complete synthetic chromosomes plus one arm combined in one strain.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Strengthened GEN-03’s distinction between 30-kilobase integration in cultured primary hepatocytes and landing-site placement in mice.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: The abstract and “Results” distinguish the primary human hepatocyte integration result from the mouse experiment, which measured landing-site placement.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Rechecked GEN-05’s mouse methylation evidence and GEN-07’s contained anti-drive evidence.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: Neither establishes the broader capability proposed.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Added GEN-10 for the historical origin of the genetic code and GEN-11 for predictive interactions beyond the regulatory code.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: Both have distinct foundational consequences at the requested scale.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Removed reliance on the historical list’s assertion that its supplied sources collectively endorsed all ten items as grand challenges.
